name: name-your-price
title: Name your price
description: Pay what you want: suggested amounts, a custom amount with a minimum and a line on what the money does, for creators selling digital work.
docs: Pass presets (usually three amounts in minor units: 500, 1200, 2500), suggested, min, currency, locale, onSubmit(amount, recurring) and an optional impact. Amounts are in minor units, as in CurrencyInput, so 1200 is 12.00. The presets are tiles in a real radio group (arrow keys move and choose); the suggested one carries a tag and is chosen at the start, because a suggested amount anchors the choice. The tiles share the row by how many there are: two or three fill it, four go four across on a wide card and two by two on a narrow one, five or more go three across. Every amount is set in one size, the largest that lets the longest of them fit its tile. impact is a list of lines with the smallest amount each is true for, and the line of the highest one the chosen amount reaches is said under the tiles, for a preset and for a custom amount, and read out politely when it changes. The custom field states its minimum; an amount below it is said in plain words next to the field and what was typed stays, and pressing the button then returns the reader to the field. Choosing a tile clears the custom amount, so the button never pays an amount the reader cannot see. Turn on monthly to add the switch that repeats the amount, and the button reads Pay 12 every month. Sending keeps the button's label, a failure keeps the choice, and success thanks the reader with what they gave; Change the amount then puts focus back on the chosen tile, or on the field when the amount was typed. onValueChange reports the chosen amount as it changes. defaultAmount and defaultStatus start the panel in a state; labels translates every fixed word.
